# Una Meredith

## Overview

- **Age:** 10 years old  <sub>[v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** Maywater  <sub>[v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v5 c4 P1](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0001), [v5 c5 P3](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Una is a pale, small girl with a tiny, delicate face that features a wistful, meditative expression and a mouth that often falls open over her small white teeth. She has dark-blue, almond-shaped eyes and straight, dead-black hair worn in braids. Although not considered pretty by conventional standards, she possesses a sweet, quiet look.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 c4 P34](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0034), [v5 c5 P11](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0011), [v5 c5 P28](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0028), [v5 c5 P39](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0039)_

## Personality

Una is a gentle, sensitive, and deeply empathetic girl who is easily hurt by harshness and distressed by the suffering of others. Shy and quiet by nature, she is deeply devoted to her family, especially her father, and frequently worries about her household's reputation. She possesses a tender, religious soul with a genuine love for prayer and spiritual comfort. Despite her timid demeanor, she is capable of great personal sacrifice and quiet courage when it comes to helping or comforting those she loves.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 c4 P34](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0034), [v5 c4 P60](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0060), [v5 c5 P28](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0028), [v5 c5 P98](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0098), [v5 c5 P111](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0111), [v5 c16 P16](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0016), [v5 c23 P15](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0015), [v5 c34 P0](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0000), [v5 c34 P23](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0023)_

## History

Una Meredith moved with her father and siblings from Maywater to the Glen St. Mary Presbyterian manse, where she quickly formed a close friendship with the Blythe children and spent much of her time playing in Rainbow Valley. She befriended Mary Vance, a homeless runaway whom the Meredith children found hiding in an old barn, and took her into the manse. Troubled by local gossip regarding her family's unruly behavior, Una joined her siblings in forming a 'Good-Conduct Club' to discipline themselves. During a self-imposed fast for the club, she fainted from hunger during a Sunday evening church service, causing a local sensation. Fearing that gossip about her family was preventing her father from marrying Rosemary West, and terrified by stories of cruel stepmothers, Una secretly visited Rosemary West to ask her to marry her father, promising that the children would be good. Upon learning the truth, Rosemary entrusted Una with a message that led to her father's successful proposal. Following her father's engagement, Una looked forward eagerly to learning household skills and welcoming Rosemary into their family.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P1](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0001), [v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046), [v5 c5 P12](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0012), [v5 c5 P101](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0101), [v5 c23 P54](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0054), [v5 c28 P0](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0000), [v5 c28 P12](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0012), [v5 c33 P2](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0002), [v5 c34 P0](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0000), [v5 c34 P13](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0013), [v5 c34 P34](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0034), [v5 c34 P40](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0040)_
